name: Custom Shape Photo Hand Fan
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality foam board and a durable wooden handle, offering a lightweight, sturdy, and easy-to-hold design.
    - The foam board features 1-sided printing for a bright and eye-catching personalized display.
    - The wooden handle has a 3mm thickness, providing a comfortable grip and reliable support during use.
    - The fan board itself has a thickness of 2.3mm, making it lightweight yet durable enough for events and celebrations.
    - Comes with adhesive tape on the handle for simple attachment to the back of the foam board.
    - Designed for both decorative and practical use at parties, ceremonies, and special occasions.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available foam board sizes:
                +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
                +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
                +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
                +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
                +) 16 x 16 in ~ 40.64 x 40.64 cm
    - Wooden handle sizes:
                +) For 6 in and 8 in toppers: 2.7 x 17 cm ~ 1.06 x 6.7 in
                +) For 10 in and 12 in toppers: 3.6 x 25 cm ~ 1.42 x 9.84 in
                +) For 16 in topper: 4.4 x 32 cm ~ 1.73 x 12.6 in
    📌 Note:  The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The foam board supports 1-sided printing for personalized photos, names, graduation themes, party designs, and celebration artwork.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized hand fan and a decorative event prop.
    - Designed to provide a convenient handheld accessory for cheering, waving, and displaying at celebrations.
    - Suitable for graduations, birthdays, parties, ceremonies, school events, and photo booth setups.
    - Lightweight and easy to carry, making it comfortable to use throughout the event.
    - Perfect for adding a fun and personalized touch to any special occasion.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for graduates, students, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for graduations, birthdays, school events, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for party favors, photo props, cheer accessories, and commemorative keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving memorable faces, names, and special moments in a fun format.
    - Great for event decorations, celebration accessories, and personalized surprise gifts.
    - Adds a fun, lively, and memorable touch to any occasion🎁

 

  • Assembly Instructions:
    - Step 1: Peel off the double-sided tape liner from the wooden handle.
    - Step 2: Align the handle on the back of the foam board.
    - Step 3: Press firmly to attach the handle securely.
    - Step 4: Make sure the handle is fixed properly before use.
    📌 Note: The handle is shipped separately and requires simple self-assembly.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Photo Hand Fan

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
